d.a: Distribution and habitat. Rhinogobius aonumai aonumai is known only from Iriomote-jima Island, the Yaeyama Group of the Ryukyu Islands, Japan. In this island, it is seen in the upper reaches of freshwater streams above waterfalls in montane areas of Geta-gawa, Hinai-gawa, Kura-gawa, Nakara-gawa, Nishida-gawa, Urauchi-gawa and Yuchin-gawa rivers, and the upper reaches of swift freshwater streams without waterfalls of Aira-gawa and Kuira-gawa rivers. In addition, we identified the gobies in the photographs taken from Arabara-gawa, Hora-gawa, and Nakama-gawa rivers registered in the Image Database of Fishes, as R. a. aonumai. The subspecies is usually found in small pools of streams, called “ Fuchi ” in Japanese.
